name: create_trace_session
description:
Create a short-lived trace session token (JWT) scoped to a deployment hostname in a project, for tracing requests to that deployment. The returned token is a credential; handle it as a secret.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/projects/traces/session --method POST. Fill placeholders from inputs.

hostname.description: The deployment hostname to scope the trace session to.

projectId.description: The project ID the deployment belongs to.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
